items.title: Patient info improperly used in radiology AI research, academic institution says
items.excerpt: Weill Cornell Medicine says it first found out about the incident on Sept. 6, immediately launching an investigation to determine what happened.

items.title: Radiology residents miss more findings after night shifts, even with AI assistance
items.excerpt: A new analysis raises questions about how overnight workloads affect diagnostic performance and whether AI tools can truly help mitigate fatigue-related risks in radiology.

items.title: "이 일을 언제까지 할 수 있을까"…소아응급 전문의가 AI 개발한 이유
items.excerpt: 삼성서울병원 응급의학과 손명희 교수가 HiPex 2026에서 소아응급실 보호자와 태블릿 음성 대화로 증상을 문진하고 요약해 의료진에게 넘기는 '소아응급 커뮤니케이션 에이전트'와 검증 체계 구축 사례를 발표했다. 소아응급 인력난을 대비해 개발했다는 설명이다.

items.title: 루닛, 의료 특화 AI 파운데이션 모델 ‘러닝유닛 2.0’ 전격 공개
items.excerpt: 루닛이 과기정통부 의과학 특화 파운데이션 모델 과제를 마치고 진료·병원 행정 업무를 지원하는 의료 특화 AI 모델 '러닝유닛 2.0'을 공개했다. 국내 9개 의료기관에서 실사용 성능을 검증했고 오픈소스로 공개한다.

items.title: 한국형 '의약품 AI 심사 보조 시스템' 12월 베일 벗는다
items.excerpt: 식약처가 추진해 온 의약품 AI 심사 보조 시스템이 12월 초 정식 공개된다. 내부 검증을 강화한 뒤 제약업계 대상 설명회를 열 계획이다.

items.title: Sunderland project using AI to help eye tests detect diabetes
items.excerpt: Researchers hope the technology will allow for a quicker diagnosis for patients.

items.title: Exeter University-led £20m project to prevent and detect dementia
items.excerpt: The BRAINIAC hub involves 10 UK brain health clinics to diagnose, prevent and treat dementia.

items.title: Apps for Caregivers Get a Dose of AI, but That Might Not Be Enough
items.excerpt: The apps and platforms that help family caregivers manage their loved ones’ needs are becoming more capable, but the broader issue of caregivers’ well-being remains unsolved.

items.title: Mass Surveillance with Artificial Intelligence — A New Determinant of Health?
items.excerpt: NEJM Perspective arguing that AI-powered mass surveillance (facial recognition, data aggregation, predictive policing) should be treated as a social determinant of health, with consequences for patients' care-seeking and clinicians' data stewardship.

items.title: Use of an Artificial Intelligence Scribe for Clinical Notes
items.excerpt: NEJM Clinical Decisions case asking clinicians whether and how to adopt an ambient AI scribe for visit notes, weighing documentation time savings against accuracy, consent and review burden.

items.title: As more doctors consult chatbots, health systems can block them — or buy in
items.excerpt: As hundreds of thousands of doctors consult AI chatbots to make care decisions, health systems see new risks to patients' health data.

items.title: FDA, CMS look to collaborate with states on health AI
items.excerpt: In this edition of STAT Health Tech: Federal officials look to work with states on regulating AI, protecting doctors from AI liability, and more.

items.title: AI depends on medical records that don’t always tell the full truth about women
items.excerpt: “For AI to achieve its full potential in women’s health, medical records need to tell the complete story,” experts write.

items.title: 7 Potential Problems with Medicare’s AI Prior Authorization Experiment
items.excerpt: The federal government is testing whether artificial intelligence can help Medicare identify unnecessary medical care, speed up the prior authorization process, and reduce healthcare spending. But a new report based on evidence recovered from a lawsuit raises concerns about the AI experiment.

items.title: AI Didn’t Reduce Clinician Burden — It Just Moved It
items.excerpt: Documentation tools have value. They solve a visible pain point well. But solving a visible pain point is not the same as solving the right one.

items.title: Patients want a human in the loop for AI healthcare tools
items.excerpt: Patients are open to doctors using AI for more administrative tasks, but they’re less enthusiastic about using it for diagnosing or claims adjudication, according to a new survey.

items.title: How should the FDA regulate generative AI in medtech? Here are 5 takes
items.excerpt: Patients, providers and medtech firms submitted hundreds of comments to the Food and Drug Administration on how the agency should approach generative AI in medical devices.

items.title: External validation of an image-only ultrasound model for delivery-date prediction in four Chilean public hospitals - npj Digital Medicine
items.excerpt: External validation of a commercial image-only ultrasound AI model that estimates gestational age / delivery date for women without a first-trimester scan, tested in four Chilean public hospitals.

items.title: MambaSleepCVD for prediction of long term cardiovascular outcomes from polysomnography - npj Digital Medicine
items.excerpt: MambaSleepCVD, a deep-learning model on overnight polysomnography signals, is tested for how much long-term cardiovascular outcome risk can be predicted from a single sleep study.

items.title: PARAMOUNT, the First Randomized Trial of AI-Enabled Plaque-Based Care, Meets Primary Endpoint in Late-Breaking Results at AHA 2026
items.excerpt: Plaque-guided care improved diagnostic certainty and increased use of preventive therapy compared with usual care in patients with suspected coronary artery disease

items.excerpt: An AI assistant that conducts telephone consultations with patients is being trialed in the NHS to help clinicians monitor people with long-term illness. items.title: FDA Grants Breakthrough Device Designation to Cleo Skin AI Pathology Tool
items.excerpt: FDA grants Breakthrough Device Designation to Primaa’s Cleo Skin AI pathology tool, which now has both CE-IVDR and FDA status.
